notes: Customer profile: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics + in-app help); heavy emphasis on predictable UX and multi-tenant data isolation.
Trial summary: 4-week Hosted API pilot. Primary paths exercised: user-facing chat (65% of calls), embeddings for search (25%), reranking pipelines (10%).
Observed trial metrics (aggregated): steady-state QPS ~12, median concurrency ~18, peak QPS observed 85 for a 30-minute burst. 95th pct concurrency ~220 during marketing event spike.

Token mix from trial: avg chat request ~120 tokens/request (prompt+response), avg embedding vector input size ~768 tokens, rerank pipeline avg combined tokens/request ~420. Monthlyized trial extrapolation -> ~120M tokens/month (current growth ~20% MoM).

Latency goals: Product team wants p95 text-gen < 250ms for short completions and average embedding latency < 40ms. Cost sensitivity: moderate; willing to commit for predictable unit cost but wants recommendations on batching + quantization tradeoffs.

Model preferences: prefer Redwood-verified open models; experimenting with 13B/70B quantized variants. Want fallback routing if chosen model is out of capacity (must preserve ≤2s tail for degraded mode).

Security/compliance: SSO (SAML), SOC2 compliance required, audit logs, KMS for key management; EU data residency for subset of customers. Legal flagged retention controls and need for a security checklist (sent in Drive).

Dedicated sizing ask: baseline sizing for expected steady-state QPS=25 (after product rollout), peak QPS=120, peak concurrency ~300, token distribution (70% short chat, 20% embeddings, 10% rerank). They asked for recommended GPU types, autoscale headroom, and expected token-unit cost under different commit levels.

AE notes: customer repeatedly: "We want predictable latency and a clear cost model before committing" — sounds like classic move from Hosted -> Dedicated. Sent preliminary pricing and asked for traffic CSV + PB(peak bursts) sample.

SE notes: propose 2x A100-equivalent nodes for baseline, add burst pool for marketing spikes; evaluate quantized 70B for quality/cost balance. Suggest Redwood Optimize run to recommend batching windows and prefix caching settings.
Procurement timeline: internal budget cycle in mid-May. Forecast close targeted 2026-05. Legal needs security addendum before procurement can proceed.
